_purpose: exhaust the free evidence for negative/exceptional/reversal outcomes before gate G4's failure becomes a permanent finding.

ui_affordance_strings: 承認コメントまたは差戻し理由を入力してください…
keyword_sweep._note: a raw hit is any occurrence of a term anywhere in an event. Hits are CLASSIFIED, not counted: only a term appearing in screen text NEXT TO A RECORD ID -- the shape every observed toast takes -- is a candidate outcome. A term in a UI placeholder proves the interface OFFERS the action, not that it happened.

_finding: NULL RESULT, and it is a finding. 31 terms swept across 1,563,587 string values (25,495,968 characters) in 20,477 events, 4,746 screenshot filenames, and 898 record-status series. ZERO outcome-like negative terms, ZERO backward transitions, ZERO records with two terminal states. Dataset B contains no observed negative outcome. G4 stays closed: there is no supervision signal for a decision function, and a model trained here would learn to approve everything and score 100%. BUT SEE _affordance_finding: the absence is of observed rejections, not of the ability to reject.
_affordance_finding: The UI EXPOSES a rejection path. The comment box on the disposition screen is labelled 「承認コメントまたは差戻し理由を入力してください…」 -- 'enter an approval comment or a send-back reason' -- appearing on browser_click and browser_form_input events. So 差戻し (send-back) is a supported action that was never exercised in this capture window. This reframes G4: the dataset does not show that rejection never happens, it shows that this ~2-hour window contains none. The distinction matters for Step 3, because a system trained or evaluated here has never seen the branch the interface is built around.
